[Verse 1]
[Eb]I know that it hurts sometimes, [F]but it's beautiful
[Gm]Working every day, now you're bleeding [Eb]through your cuticles
Passing through a portal as you're sittin' [F]in your cubicle
[Dm]Isn't life beautiful? I think that [Bb]life is beautiful
[Eb]Tryin' to keep your cool at your [F]grandfather's funeral
[Gm]Finding out eventually the feeling [Eb]wasn't mutual
You were not invited 'cause you're nothing [F]like the usual
[Dm]Isn't life beautiful? I think that [Bb]life is beautiful You
[Eb]wanna see your friends, but you're stuck [F]inside a hospital
[Gm]Doctor walks in and he tells you [Eb]that it's terminal
Tumor in your brain and they're say in' [F]it's inoperable
[Dm]Isn't life beautiful? I think that [Bb]life is beautiful They'll
[Eb]kill your little brother and they'll tell you [F]he's a criminal They'll
[Gm]fucking kill you too, so you better [Eb]not get physical
Welcome to America, the type of [F]shit is typical
[Dm]Isn't life beautiful? I think that [Bb]life is beautiful

[Verse 2]
[Eb]Wake up in the morning, now you doing [F]the impossible
[Gm]Find out what's important, now you're feeling [Eb]philosophical
When I die, I'll pack my bags, move somewhere [F]more affordable
[Dm]Isn't life horrible? I think that [Bb]life is horrible
[Eb]You think she's adorable, she thinks that [F]you're intolerable
[Gm]You think you can do it, but your chances [Eb]are improbable
Once you feel unstoppable, you run [F]into an obstacle
[Dm]Isn't life comical? I think that [Bb]life is comical

[Verse 3]
[Eb]And if you ever need a friend [F]then you got me
[Gm]And in the end, when I die, [Eb]would you watch me?
And if I try suicide, [F]would you stop me?
[Dm]Would you help me get a grip or [Bb]would you drop me?
[Eb]Run away, make friends [F]with the moon
[Gm]Why you trippin'? You'll be with your [Eb]friends soon
There comes a time when everybody [F]meets the same fate
[Dm]I think I'ma die alone [Bb]inside my room
